selection: Largest control hold with all six old fixed courses passing; otherwise do not launch SMDP training. All cadence outcomes retained.
policy_input: unchanged 112 dimensions; no task ID, map, obstacle coordinates, planner or waypoints

next_training_predeclaration.reward: discounted native-step reward sum including same T59/T66, divided by constant control-hold length
next_training_predeclaration.critic_initialization: fresh; one-step old replay/Critic not reused for SMDP semantics
next_training_predeclaration.retention_teacher: frozen T159 on all six successful task state banks
next_training_predeclaration.final_goals: 23 endpoint-feasible goals from fixed-start audit plus the two original 5m goals; no intermediate waypoints

study_type: declared multi-change engineering pilot; not a controlled new-algorithm superiority claim
